title: CUA-Master: Scaling Computer-use Agents through Open-World Recursive Improvements
title_zh: CUA-Master：通过开放世界递归改进规模化计算机使用智能体

paragraphs.en: CUA-Master通过双循环递归改进框架规模化构建计算机使用智能体，在多个基准上表现领先。 Despite recent advances in CUAs, their development remains constrained by the limited diversity, controllability, and reliability of interaction data. Moreover, conventional optimization pipelines lack iterative feedback, while existing recursive improvement approaches often rely on self-generated experiences, limiting ability expansion and yielding diminishing returns. To address these challenges, we introduce CUA-Master, a nested double-loop recursive improvement framework. At the system level, an outer world-data-model flywheel continuously incorporates open-world corpus and leverages evolving model weaknesses to guide subsequent data construction and optimization iterations. At the data level, an inner flywheel couples open-world seeding and autocatalytic propagation. The former mines authentic workflows as seed tasks from instructional videos, and employs visual-semantic dual-path trajectory reconstruction; The latter transforms these seeds into reusable primitives for controllable synthesis of diverse, complex, and verifiable tasks. To enable efficient and reliable trajectory collection, we further introduce a feedback-guided snapshot-rollback retry mechanism in various real environments. Extensive experiments demonstrate that CUA-Master-27B achieves competitive performance across GUI-only and GUI-CLI hybrid benchmarks, scoring 80.2 on OSWorld Verified, 36.9 on OSWorld 2.0, 43.9 on WeaveBench, and 25.0 on Agents' Last Exam. Our framework also substantially improves the quality and efficiency of data synthesis, and exhibits continuous gains across recursive iterations.
paragraphs.zh: CUA-Master通过双循环递归改进框架规模化构建计算机使用智能体，在多个基准上表现领先。尽管计算机使用智能体（CUA）近来取得进展，但其发展仍受限于交互数据的多样性、可控性和可靠性不足。 此外，传统的优化流程缺乏迭代反馈，而现有的递归改进方法往往依赖自我生成的经验，限制了能力扩展并导致收益递减。 为应对这些挑战，我们提出了CUA-Master，一个嵌套双循环递归改进框架。 在系统层面，外部的世界-数据-模型飞轮持续纳入开放世界语料，并利用不断演化的模型弱点来指导后续的数据构建与优化迭代。 在数据层面，内部的飞轮将开放世界播种与自催化扩散相结合。 前者从教学视频中挖掘真实工作流作为种子任务，并采用视觉-语义双路径轨迹重建；后者将这些种子转化为可复用的原语，用于可控地合成多样、复杂且可验证的任务。 为实现高效可靠的轨迹收集，我们进一步在多种真实环境中引入了反馈引导的快照回滚重试机制。 大量实验表明，CUA-Master-27B在纯GUI与GUI-CLI混合基准上均取得了有竞争力的表现，在OSWorld Verified上得分80.2，在OSWorld 2.0上得分36.9，在WeaveBench上得分43.9，在Agents' Last Exam上得分25.0。 我们的框架还显著提升了数据合成的质量与效率，并在递归迭代中展现出持续提升。
